title: National Civil Rights Museum

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: The National Civil Rights Museum located at the Lorraine Motel brings to life one of the most significant epochs of American history at a beautiful site that offers a unique and inspiring environment for special occasions. Available for use to non-profit, social, and civic organizations, as well as corporations and businesses, the museum offers state-of-the-art facilities ideal for corporate events, conferences, receptions, dinners, and educational experiences for all ages. The National Civil Rights Museum serves as a catalyst to inspire action to create positive social change and facility rental events should align with this mission. The museum reserves the right to restrict any events
